title: Sign-up form with password visibility and validation
prompt: Build a "Create account" form with the fields "Email", "Password" and "Confirm password", and a "Create account" button. The Password field has a button named "Show password" that switches the password between hidden and visible text; while it is visible, the button is named "Hide password". On submit, show each error next to its field and mark that field as invalid with aria-invalid="true": "Enter a valid email address" for a bad email, "Use at least 8 characters" for a shorter password, and "Passwords do not match" when the confirmation differs. When everything is valid, replace the form with the text "Account created".
